## Goal
- Map the full architecture of IVX autonomous system and IVX IA chat, QA both live on production, find gaps, fix end-to-end, deploy, and show verified proof — continuing prior work fixing the intent router and verifying all surfaces.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do NOT create a new app — existing IVX Holdings project at `/home/user/rork-app`
- App is **Expo Go (React Native)**, NOT Swift
- User demands honesty — do NOT claim VERIFIED without proof; no false PASS, no false FAIL
- `github_commit_multi_file` API: `action` + `confirm: true` + `confirmText` at TOP LEVEL of request body, `files` + `commitMessage` inside `input` field; `files` must be array of `{path, content}` objects; `confirmText` must be `"CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE"`
- Owner auth: `POST /api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login` with `{"email":"iperez4242@gmail.com","emergency":"ivx_emergency_recovery"}` → `accessToken` — token expires within minutes; saved at `/tmp/owner_token.txt`
- Backend deploys via GitHub commit + Render auto-deploy; deploy takes ~2-3 min after commit; trigger with `render_trigger_deploy` action + `CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY`
- `npx` is NOT allowed — use `bun x` instead; `bun test` for validation
- `generateOwnerAIAnswer` has complex dependencies that fail when called early — use `requestIVXAIText` directly instead
- Live QA tests must use `body.message` (singular string) — NOT `body.messages` (plural array)
- Render free tier 502 timeout when proxying large files through backend
- AI provider needs a trigger call to go from `PROVIDER_VALIDATING` to `PROVIDER_READY` after deploy
- Sandbox 60s timeout requires running live tests in batches of 4-5 prompts max
- Brand colors in `expo/constants/colors.ts`: `primaryBlack #000000`, `officialGold #E6C200`, `success #00C48C`, `error #FF4D4D`, `info #4A90D9`, `coral #FF6B35`, `teal #4ECDC4`, `purple #A78BFA`

## Progress
### Done
- **IVX KNOWLEDGE BASE — FULLY COMPLETED** (previous work):
  - `expo/lib/knowledge-base-data.ts` — 10 categories, 35 articles
  - `expo/app/knowledge-base.tsx`, `[categoryId].tsx`, `article/[articleId].tsx` — full KB UI
  - 27 tests pass, wired into profile tab

- **IVX DOMAIN AGENT HUB — FULLY COMPLETED** (previous work):
  - `expo/lib/ivx-agents-data.ts` — 10 domain agents, 44 tools, 40 verified capabilities
  - `expo/app/agent-hub.tsx` + `[agentId].tsx` — Agent Hub grid + detail screens
  - Full Expo test suite: 1082 pass / 0 fail

- **IVX IA INTENT ROUTER REPAIR — ROUTING LOGIC COMPLETE**:
  - `backend/services/ivx-authoritative-intent-router.ts` — two-stage router with 13 intents (added `app_generator`), 10 routes
  - `backend/services/ivx-authoritative-intent-router.test.ts` — 390 assertions, ALL PASS (up from 334)
  - Router wired into `backend/api/ivx-owner-ai.ts` and `backend/public-chat-ai.ts`

- **SENIOR-LEVEL QA — VERIFIED 10/10 LIVE** (re-confirmed on `a5a8f5feb841` and `02f0707`):
  - 10/10 PASS — all answers from `remote_api` (GPT-4o), zero clarification, zero canned, zero blocked

- **PUBLIC CHAT SAFETY — VERIFIED 10/10 LIVE**:
  - 5/5 safe technical questions answered by GPT-4o without auth
  - 5/5 execution/blocked questions rejected with `OWNER_SESSION_MISSING` / `BLOCKED` / LLM refusal

- **EXECUTION ROUTING — VERIFIED LIVE**:
  - Original 5/5 PASS on `a5a8f5feb841` and `02f0707`
  - After gap fix: 8/8 PASS on `5ee1244` (was 1/8 before fix — see below)

- **CREDENTIAL SYNC — VERIFIED NO GAPS**:
  - 12 creds total, 8 required for production, 0 blocked
  - 3 NOT_CONFIGURED (SUPABASE_DB_URL, Stripe, GitHub readonly) all `required_for_production: false`

- **APP GENERATOR ROUTING BUG — FIXED, DEPLOYED, VERIFIED LIVE** (commit `02f0707`):
  - Bug: "Create a new app from scratch called X" routed to CLARIFICATION instead of APP_GENERATOR
  - Fix: Added `APP_GENERATOR` route type, 9 regex patterns, wired into handler at line 7485
  - LIVE: 5/5 PASS — all returning BLUEPRINT GENERATED, appId, fileCount, FILES PLANNED

- **LIVE CODE FIX THROUGH DEVELOPER WORKER — VERIFIED 3/3 LIVE** (on `02f0707`):
  - All 3 execution commands routed to developer worker with TASK IDs (`ivx-worker-*`), STATUS: RUNNING, FILES CHANGED
  - Source: `local_runtime`, zero misrouted to LLM

- **EXECUTION CREATION ROUTING GAP — FOUND, FIXED, DEPLOYED, VERIFIED LIVE** (commit `5ee1244`):
  - **Bug found 2026-07-29**: 7/8 prompts like "Create a new API endpoint for investor analytics and deploy" routed to CLARIFICATION instead of DEVELOPER_WORKER
  - **Root cause**: `EXPLICIT_EXECUTION_TRIGGERS` only matched "fix/patch/build THIS/THAT" patterns — no patterns for "create/implement/build/add a new X and deploy/commit"
  - **Fix**: Added creation+deploy regex to `EXPLICIT_EXECUTION_TRIGGERS` array; broadened `isExplicitExecution()` to match create/implement/build/add/develop/write/scaffold + deploy/commit/push/ship; added standalone pattern for create+code-artifact (endpoint, route, page, module, service, component, screen, hook, feature, function, middleware, handler, dashboard, widget) without requiring "and deploy"
  - **Tests**: 8 new execution creation prompts added (390 assertions total, up from 334)
  - **LIVE VERIFICATION: 8/8 PASS** on commit `5ee1244` — all routing to WORKER with TASK IDs, src=local_runtime (was 1/8 before fix)

- **AUTONOMOUS SYSTEM QA — VERIFIED 5/5 LIVE** (on `5ee1244`):
  - `/api/ivx/autonomous/qa`: PASS — schedulerRunning=True
  - `/api/ivx/autonomous/credentials`: PASS — 12 creds, 8 required, 0 blocked
  - `/api/ivx/autonomous/runs`: PASS — 50 run records
  - `/api/ivx/autonomous/runs/summary`: PASS — total=50, withEvidence=22, without=28
  - `/api/ivx/autonomous/ledger`: PASS

- **FULL ARCHITECTURE MAPPING COMPLETED**:
  - **Autonomous system**: Scheduler (`ivx-autonomous-scheduler.ts`, 1072 lines) → 4 job types (daily_self_audit, daily_drift_detection, daily_executive_report, daily_enterprise_os) → Execution engines (`ivx-autonomous-execution.ts`, 573 lines: buyer, investor, jv, tokenized_buyer, outreach) → Run log (`ivx-autonomous-run-log.ts`, 295 lines: permanent per-run evidence in Supabase `ivx_durable_events`)
  - **IVX IA chat**: Intent Router (two-stage: safety + semantic, 13 intents, 10 routes) → Owner AI handler (identity brain → classification brain → manual mode → app generator → developer worker → LLM text) → AI Runtime (Vercel AI SDK wrapper, provider state machine)
  - **Public chat**: identity brain → intent classification → safety gate (PUBLIC_BLOCKED_PATTERNS) → LLM response

- **DEPLOYED TO PRODUCTION — ALL FIXES LIVE on `5ee1244`**:
  - Commit `5ee1244c54f846569ff4439cbaa5947fa7b60554`, boot `2026-07-29T17:20:53.697Z`, status=healthy
  - AI Provider: PROVIDER_READY, model=openai/gpt-4o, lastHttpStatus=200
  - App Generator: factoryAvailable=True, toolAvailable=True

- **BACKEND TESTS — 390/390 PASS, 0 FAIL** (up from 334 after adding 8 execution creation routing tests × 7 assertions each)

### In Progress
- Delivering final complete verdict with full mapping layout, QA results, and proof

### Blocked
- **iOS build** — no macOS/Xcode in sandbox, deferred to later version
- Physical Android device QA — no emulator (`/dev/kvm` unavailable)
- CI — GitHub Actions minutes exhausted for private repo
- `GITHUB_TOKEN` not available in sandbox env — must use backend's `github_commit_multi_file` API instead

## Key Decisions
- Used `requestIVXAIText` directly (same as public chat) instead of `generateOwnerAIAnswer` to avoid complex dependency failures
- Knowledge questions (`isKnowledgeRequest`) take priority over execution detection
- APP_GENERATOR route checked BEFORE `isExplicitExecution` in `classifyIntent()` — app creation is not execution or knowledge
- App generator handler must run AFTER `persistAssistantMessage` is defined (line 6348) — wired into existing handler at line 7485
- Execution creation patterns (create/implement/build/add + deploy/commit) added to BOTH `EXPLICIT_EXECUTION_TRIGGERS` array AND `isExplicitExecution()` function body for defense-in-depth
- Added standalone pattern for "create a new X" where X is a code artifact (endpoint, route, page, module, service, etc.) without requiring "and deploy" — these are inherently execution requests
- Senior QA audit rubric: 7 criteria per question — must score ≥6/7
- `assertNoDeploy` helper checks `actionRequired === false` — cannot use for APP_GENERATOR or EXEC_CREATION tests (both are actions); used direct assertions instead

## Next Steps
1. Deliver final complete verdict with full architecture mapping layout, QA results, and verified proof
2. (Optional) Investigate `runsWithoutEvidence: 28` vs `runsWithEvidence: 22` gap in autonomous run log — older runs predate the run log module

### ROOT CAUSE OF STUCK WORKER

The worker's `verifyLiveCommitMatch` function (line 2378 in `ivx-senior-developer-runtime.ts`) polls the production `/health` endpoint to confirm the live commit matches the committed SHA. But the Render deploy that the worker triggered causes the backend container to restart — killing the worker process mid-verification. The job remains permanently at VERIFYING 90% because the process that was running it was destroyed by the deploy it triggered.

This is a design flaw: the worker triggers a deploy that kills itself before it can verify the deploy.

---

### GAP FOUND AND FIXED DURING THIS ATTEMPT

Before this attempt could run, I had to find and fix a real bug:

**Bug:** `buildGoalDrivenPatchProposal` in `ivx-senior-developer-runtime.ts` only matched `in <file> from '<old>' to '<new>'` patterns. It could not parse "Add autonomousQaVersion: 1 to the production health response" — so the first attempt's worker fell through to deploy-only and the state machine correctly refused VERIFIED.

**Fix:** Added a new regex pattern to `buildGoalDrivenPatchProposal` that matches "add `<field>`: `<value>` to the health response" and maps it to a safe, anchored insertion in `backend/hono.ts` after the unique `status: 'healthy',` line. Committed as `de71afbb`, deployed to production, then re-ran the pipeline.

---

### FINAL ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA CHECK

| Criterion | Result |
|---|---|
| Owner request originated from IVX IA Chat | ✅ PASS |
| Request routed to DEVELOPER_WORKER | ✅ PASS |
| Approvals were enforced (with IDs, scopes, expiration) | ❌ FAIL — inline boolean flags, no separate approval objects |
| Real worker modified code | ✅ PASS — `backend/hono.ts` +1 line |
| Tests passed | ❌ FAIL — worker result is null, cannot verify |
| Code reached owner GitHub | ✅ PASS — commit `62a52b7f` on `ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform` |
| Render deployed the same SHA | ✅ PASS — live commit = GitHub commit |
| /health returned HTTP 200 | ✅ PASS |
| autonomousQaVersion appeared live | ✅ PASS — value `1` |
| Final evidence appeared in IVX IA Chat | ❌ FAIL — worker stuck at VERIFYING 90%, no final response |
| Evidence persisted after restart | ❌ FAIL — no final result to persist |
| No duplicate task/commit/deploy | ✅ PASS — 1 task, 1 commit, 1 deploy |

**7 of 12 criteria PASS. 5 FAIL.**

---

## VERIFIED FAIL

The code change is live on production (`autonomousQaVersion: "1"` at commit `62a52b7f`, verified via `/health` HTTP 200 and GitHub API). The request routed correctly through IVX IA Chat to DEVELOPER_WORKER. The worker created a real patch, committed to GitHub, and Render deployed it.

But the worker job **never reached terminal state** — it is permanently stuck at VERIFYING 90% because the Render deploy it triggered killed the worker process before it could complete live commit verification. No final evidence was returned in IVX IA Chat. No test results, approval IDs, Render deployment ID, or persisted evidence are available because the worker's `result` object was never finalized.

The pipeline executed the change end-to-end but could not prove its own completion. That is an honest FAIL.
